band_pooling_mechanism.verification_kind: Independent source and algebra inspection; retained synthetic execution inspected
band_pooling_mechanism.algebra: For a patch with fixed masks and metadata, the shared channel projection is W[v_c,m_c]+b. Count averaging produces W times the count-weighted channel-value sum, plus fixed mask and metadata terms. With equal observed counts, opposite changes delta and minus-delta to two normalized channels cancel before temporal nonlinear processing. Subsequent attention and pooling receive the same tokens and cannot recover the lost frequency-value association.
band_pooling_mechanism.applicability: The exact cancellation is a fixed-mask/fixed-metadata counterexample. It does not assert invariance under arbitrary mask, count or metadata changes.
